title: Mise non-food illustration manifest
description: Provenance record for every appliance, state, onboarding, technique, action, dish, and cuisine illustration shipped inside assets/illustrations/. An asset that is not listed here is not approved for distribution. Food illustrations are keyed by canonical ingredient id and carry a FoodClass, so they keep their own manifest in assets/food/.

assets.description: Keyed '<set>/<id>'. The set is part of the key because id spaces overlap across sets — 'blender' is both an appliance and a plausible technique subject.

set.description: Must match the set segment of this entry's key.

assetId.description: Must match the id segment of this entry's key. Appliance ids use underscores because they are ApplianceId values from src/types.ts.

sourceModel.description: The tool and model that actually produced the file. Never a description of a pipeline that did not run.

reviewedBy.description: The human who accepted this asset. Required: approval is a person, not a timestamp.

outputChecksum.description: Verified against the bytes on disk by test/illustration-registries.test.ts.
